title: SSP-3.2 — Verification And Owner Transfer Evidence
summary: final evidence for ordinary semantic usage, local Folder isolation, source snapshots and durable Insert subject link ownership
content_html:
SSP-3.2 — Verification And Owner Transfer Evidence

Outcome

SSP-3 is complete. Insert subject link remains a small Manage Source contribution over existing owners: exact document subject metadata supplies identity, Catalogue lookup and serialization supply Work/Series bytes, local-folder serialization and non-opening validation supply Folder bytes, and ordinary Source replacement owns the buffer change.

Work and Series tokens enter the unchanged semantic-token parser, resolver, rendered-link, and docs_semantic_token_usage_index_v1 occurrence path. They receive no subject-link origin or aboutness meaning. Folder links retain one encoded relative target, activate only through the Manage local-link handler, and become inert text through the existing public promotion sanitization.

Inserted source is a snapshot. The focused Source integration keeps the Work bytes unchanged after the available metadata subject is reassigned to Series. The subject-assignment service test preserves a body containing both semantic and local links verbatim through Folder change, removal, and Work assignment; rebuild continues to interpret only the authored references themselves.

Focused Evidence

  • 45 focused Python tests pass across Docs payload and usage generation, semantic-token resolution, public payload and promotion isolation, local-link validation, management routes, and body preservation during subject reassignment.
  • Catalogue-token, local-folder-link, and configured-router module smokes pass. The Source integration protects exact target metadata reads, ordinary replacement, dirty/focus behavior, and the non-rewriting snapshot.
  • The Manage shell smoke and exact live dotlineform/projects Source review confirm the action is present, an inserted Series token uses the current title, and its rendered link is rebased to the site preview origin.
  • The seven-check source-lint profile passes with summary var/admin/test-runs/20260806-225033/summary.md.
  • Studio docs and search rebuilds plus generated-payload parsing and git diff --check pass.

Owner Transfer

  • Source Editor Scripts owns exact mounted-target reads and ordinary Source replacement, dirty state, focus, and snapshot behavior.
  • Source Editor Endpoints owns the metadata read and non-opening Folder validation transport boundary.
  • Semantic Tokens Source Editor UI owns the distinct subject-link action's use of existing Catalogue identity, title, and serializer behavior.
  • Semantic Tokens Architecture owns ordinary mention usage with no origin or aboutness reinterpretation.
  • The existing local-folder module owner retains relative-path serialization, validation, Manage activation, and public inertness.

Independent Review

Final code and delivery review found no unresolved issue. Identity never falls back from the exact managed target; no concurrency, save, rebuild, front-matter, Resolver, Project State, relationship expansion, or public local-target behavior was added. The async sub-scope detail mount now completes before existing semantic and local links are activated, preserving the site-preview destination for rendered inserted tokens.
